user.title: Perm Energosbyt: account number
user.description: Enter your account number (лицевой счёт). The integration will check the site to find out how many tariffs your meter has, and will ask for a sensor for each one on the next step.

tariffs.title: Perm Energosbyt: sensors and schedule
tariffs.description:
According to the site, your meter has these tariffs: {tariffs_summary}. Specify which Home Assistant sensors hold the current reading for each tariff, and when to send readings automatically. Before saving, the integration checks that the selected sensors exist and return a number.

IMPORTANT: pick a send date at least 2 days before your reading submission deadline. If the site is unavailable, the integration retries several times over 2 days - this margin lets the retries run, and leaves you time to submit readings manually before the deadline if they all fail.

error.account_not_found: Account number not found on lk.permenergosbyt.ru
error.unsupported_tariff_count: This meter has a tariff outside the supported T1-T3 range - the integration can't handle it yet

init.title: Perm Energosbyt: settings
init.description:
Reading sensors and the automatic send schedule. The day of month is 1-28, so it doesn't depend on the month's length. The set of tariffs was determined at setup from the site's data and can't be changed here - only which sensor is mapped to which tariff. Before saving, the integration checks that the selected sensors exist and return a number.

IMPORTANT: pick a send date at least 2 days before your reading submission deadline - this is a margin for a site outage (retries run for up to 2 days) and for a manual send if every retry still fails.

error.sensor_check_failed: Could not read the readings from the selected sensors: {sensor_error}
